description: Introducing the NIUMM, NIU's groundbreaking entry into the four-wheel market, leveraging over a decade of leadership in electric two-wheelers. This microcar is designed to empower your urban exploration and redefine city travel.

components.description: Compact, electric, and agile – the NIUMM is your perfect city companion. Glide through traffic and fit into tight spaces with ease
Powered by the advanced drivetrain and lithium battery system from our flagship NQiX moped. Trusted by thousands, now in four wheels.
Enjoy smooth, silent acceleration with zero emissions. Ideal for daily commutes and short city trips.
Charge at home, work, or anywhere. Upgrade to four batteries and double your range for extended flexibility.

components.type_detail: Smart & Secure with the NIU App
components.description: Real-time GPS, anti-theft alerts, and full vehicle control right from your smartphone. Always connected, always in control.
Room for two, intuitive steering, and features like electric windows, defroster, and optional AC – city driving just got smarter.
